routines.notes: Manual/on-demand timesheet narrative routine. Scheduled execution remains disabled by default.

routines.name: Belief engine — all enabled domains
routines.notes: Loops over every domain marked enabled in configs/belief_domains.yaml and updates that domain's beliefs from the last 14 days of daily insights + ticket signals. Adding / disabling a domain is a YAML edit, not a code change. Domain failures are logged but don't abort the rest. After all domains succeed, the adapter exports active beliefs to resource_user_beliefs.json inline — atomic with the run, no fixed-time race against a slow upstream.

routines.name: Belief engine — manual re-export
routines.notes: DISABLED for scheduled execution — belief_engine now exports inline at the end of its run. Pipeline registration kept so an operator can /run-routine belief_engine_export for a manual re-export. Content-guarded — file only rewrites if beliefs changed.

routines.name: KG maintenance pipeline
routines.notes: Weekly KG maintenance scan: orphan nodes, missing descriptions, suspect nodes (LLM), duplicate pairs (LLM random sampling). All findings are written to kg_maintenance_finding table for review at /kg-maintenance.

routines.name: KG finding backlog drain
routines.notes: Daily: investigate up to 5 oldest pending kg_maintenance_findings (FIFO drain). Picks from the global pending queue, complementing the weekly kg_maintenance_pipeline which only investigates findings produced by its own run.

routines.name: Entity card maintenance pipeline
routines.notes: Weekly entity card quality scan: broken KG links, junk names, blank content, low confidence, stale content, no KG link. All findings written to entity_card_maintenance_finding for review at /entity-card-maintenance.

routines.name: Fetch email
routines.notes: Periodic email fetch across all active Gmail OAuth accounts. Replaces BackgroundTaskManager round-robin data_fetch.

routines.name: Fetch calendar events
routines.notes: Periodic calendar sync. Defaults to local midnight → +7 days when no dates provided.

routines.name: Fetch todo tasks
routines.notes: Periodic Google Tasks sync.

routines.name: Fetch weather
routines.notes: Periodic weather update. City defaults from resource_current_location.json.

routines.name: Fetch news
routines.notes: Periodic news fetch from configured RSS feeds. Empty feed_urls falls back to DEFAULT_FEEDS.

routines.name: Fetch scheduler events
routines.notes: Periodic internal scheduler event sync. Defaults to midnight → +7 days.

routines.name: Situation Auditor
routines.notes: Periodic background audit of all active context. Checks for contradictions, conflicts, and anomalies across data sources. Notifies user of findings via chat. Passive observer only — does not modify plans or tasks.

routines.name: Location Refresh
routines.notes: Rebuilds user location timeline from calendar events and updates resource_current_location.json. Used by weather tool and location_summary context.

routines.name: Chat Memory Indexer
routines.notes: Indexes recent chat summaries and user messages into ChromaDB for conversational memory RAG. Summaries indexed over 90 days, user messages over 14 days.

routines.name: Claim Proposal Promoter (nightly)
routines.notes: Nightly sweep over pending claim_proposals. Auto-promotes anything resolvable + conflict-free. Held proposals (conflicts, lock violations, placeholders) stay in the review queue. Manual trigger: POST /kg-proposals/run-promoter (dry-run) or ?commit=1.

routines.name: KG importance rater (nodes + edges)
routines.notes: Rates any node/edge with NULL importance via me::edge_importance_rater + me::importance_rater. Cheap, idempotent, runs every 30 min so the wiki refresh's importance pre-filter has scores by the time it runs.

routines.name: KG state/event date investigator (drain)
routines.notes: Drains pending state_missing_dates findings through kg_investigation_manager with the specialized state-dates brief (dated neighbors, conversation-evidence window, sibling states). Investigator emits proposed_action.op='fill_dates' with confidence; high-confidence ones get auto-applied by kg_finding_executor_drain. Limit 8/day keeps LLM cost bounded — raise if the backlog (hundreds today) doesn't shrink fast enough.

routines.name: Wiki connection investigator (suggest new KG edges)
routines.notes: Reads the 10 freshest wiki pages and runs wiki_connection_investigator to propose edges (and sometimes new target nodes) the page implies but the KG doesn't yet have. Proposals flow through the standard claim_proposal pipeline so the promoter's merge gates apply. Runs after wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) and the cluster/executor drains so it sees the freshest pages and only generates novel proposals.

routines.name: KG finding executor drain (apply or escalate)
routines.notes: Drains the oldest investigated findings through kg_mutation_manager — applies the proposed_action when the investigator's confidence is high enough, otherwise calls kg_finding_escalate which writes a user-facing question. Closes the self-healing loop: pending → investigated → executed (or → escalated for user prose-resolve). Runs after the cluster resolver (03:30) so leads aren't applied separately from siblings.

routines.name: KG finding cluster resolver (distill redundant findings)
routines.notes: Reads pending findings, groups by primary_node_id, calls kg_finding_cluster_resolver to verify which candidate clusters share ONE root question. Confirmed leads get synthesized root_question; siblings get superseded_by stamped (hidden from default UI). Resolving a lead cascades to its siblings. Runs after wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) so wiki_contradiction findings of the same night are eligible for clustering.

routines.name: KG state decay (nightly auto-close)
routines.notes: Auto-closes State/Event nodes whose TTL has elapsed (uses attributes.last_observed + attributes.ttl, GRACE_DAYS=3). Runs after proposal_promoter (02:30) so freshly-promoted nodes are in the candidate set, and before wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) so closures flow into the wiki the same night. Nightly cadence so the graph doesn't accumulate ghost-open states between weekly maintenance runs.

routines.name: Wiki nightly refresh
routines.notes: Scans the vault, regenerates only sections affected by KG node/edge updates since each page's generated_at, then runs the consistency critic. Runs after proposal_promoter (02:30) so newly-promoted nodes flow into the wiki the same night.

routines.name: Wiki growth (build new pages)
routines.notes: Builds up to max_new_pages new prose pages each night for the highest-degree Entity nodes that don't yet have one. Runs after wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00). Pairs with refresh: refresh maintains existing pages, growth adds new ones. Tune max_new_pages to control daily LLM spend; raise temporarily if a one-off catch-up is needed.

routines.name: Sleep camera capture (every 3 min)
routines.notes: Captures one frame from the bed-facing Ring camera every ~3 minutes. The bridge fires ring_snapshot_captured; sleep_analyzer picks it up, finds the previous frame, and writes a structured .txt sidecar including motion-vs-previous. DISABLED by default — flip enabled=true at bedtime, false in the morning. Camera_id is the Downstairs cam (re-aimed at bed); change spec.camera_id if a different camera is repurposed.

routines.name: Sleep camera capture — LOCAL RTSP (every 3 min)
routines.notes: Higher-res alternative to sleep_camera_tick — pulls a 1080p frame from a configured RTSP camera (Tapo / Wyze / Reolink) instead of Ring's 640×360 thumbnail. Requires the camera to be in configs/smart_home_tools.json under local_cameras.devices with kind=bedroom. The local_camera_snapshot tool fires the same ring_snapshot_captured event; sleep_analyzer picks up Tapo frames via the kind=bedroom filter. DISABLED by default — flip enabled=true at bedtime, false in the morning. To migrate from Ring, disable sleep_camera_tick and enable this one.
